questions.stem: 很難想像，數百萬人每天依賴的水，是由高山上正在融化的冰川（glaciers）提供的。
questions.answer: It is hard to imagine that the water millions of people rely on daily is provided by melting glaciers high in the mountains.
accepted_answers: It is difficult to imagine that the water which millions of people depend on every day is supplied by melting glaciers in high mountains.
It is hard to imagine that the water millions of people rely on every day is provided by glaciers that are melting high up in the mountains.

patterns: 虛主詞 It ＋形容詞＋不定詞

questions.stem: 然而，近年來它們已經受到全球暖化的嚴重影響，造成數百萬人面臨缺水危機。
questions.answer: However, in recent years, they have already been severely affected by global warming, causing millions of people to face water shortages.
accepted_answers: However, in recent years, they have been seriously affected by global warming, leaving millions of people facing a water crisis.
However, they have been badly affected by global warming in recent years, putting millions of people at risk of a water crisis.

patterns: 句尾分詞片語表結果（, causing …）

1.explanation_zh: 「很難想像」沒有主詞，用虛主詞 It is hard／difficult to imagine that …，真正的內容放在 that 子句裡。「數百萬人每天依賴的水」修飾語在前，英文改成 the water (that) millions of people rely on every day（rely 要加 on；也可用 depend on）。「是由…提供的」：水是被提供的一方，用被動 is provided／supplied by …。「高山上正在融化的冰川」可寫 melting glaciers high in the mountains，或用分詞片語後位修飾 glaciers melting high in the mountains。
evidence: 數百萬人每天依賴的水
1.strategy_zh: 「很難／很容易＋動詞」→ It is + adj. + to V；「…的＋名詞」→ 名詞 + (that) + S + V（後位修飾）。
hints: 切成四段：很難想像／數百萬人每天依賴的水／高山上正在融化的冰川／是由…提供的
標的詞彙：hard（困難的）、imagine（想像）、million（百萬）、water（水）、rely on（依賴，也可用 depend on）、day（每天）、melt（融化）、mountain（山）、provide（提供）
句型框架：It is hard to imagine that + the N (that) + S + V + is provided by …

2.explanation_zh: 「然而」承接上一句「冰川提供用水」，轉到危機；「它們」指冰川，用 they。「近年來已經受到…的影響」是延續到現在的結果，冰川又是「受到」影響的一方，用完成式被動 have (already) been seriously affected by global warming；「嚴重」修飾動詞，用副詞 seriously／severely。「造成…」沒有主詞，是前面整件事的結果，用句尾分詞 , causing + 受詞 + to face …（也可寫 leaving millions of people facing …、putting millions of people at risk of …）。「缺水危機」名詞化成 a water crisis 或 water shortages。
evidence: 已經受到全球暖化的嚴重影響
造成數百萬人面臨缺水危機
2.strategy_zh: 「已經被／受到…」→ have been + p.p.；「…，造成…」接在逗號後沒有主詞 → 句尾分詞 causing + O + to V。
hints: 切成四段：然而，近年來它們／已經受到全球暖化的嚴重影響／造成數百萬人／面臨缺水危機
標的詞彙：recent（近來的）、affect（影響）、global warming（全球暖化）、seriously（嚴重地）、cause（造成）、million（百萬）、face（面臨）、water（水）、crisis（危機，也可用 shortage）
句型框架：However, in recent years, S + have been seriously affected by …, causing + O + to face + N

traps.explanation_zh: 「缺水危機」是濃縮的複合概念，英文名詞化成 a water crisis 或 water shortages，不要把「缺」直譯成 lack 硬塞在名詞前面。

bonus.text: So severely have they been affected by global warming in recent years that millions of people now face a water crisis.
bonus.explanation_zh: So + 副詞 + 助動詞 + 主詞 … that …（倒裝）強調「影響嚴重到…」。倒裝只是加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

2.restructuring_zh: 「造成數百萬人面臨…」接在逗號後沒有主詞，是前面「冰川受到影響」造成的結果，英文用句尾分詞 , causing millions of people to face …；「缺水危機」名詞化成 a water crisis 或 water shortages。

warnings: annotations.rubric.items.2.patterns[0]: gp-perfect-passive 通常對應句構 PERF（目前 code=PASS）

1.translation: It is hard to imagine that the water millions of people depend on every day is provided by melting glaciers in high mountains.
1.explanation_zh: 「很難想像」用虛主詞 It is hard to imagine that…；「數百萬人每天依賴的水」用省略 that 的限定關係子句 the water (that) millions of people depend on；「是由…提供的」用被動 is provided by；「正在融化的冰川」用前置分詞 melting glaciers（也可 glaciers that are melting）。

2.translation: However, in recent years they have been seriously affected by global warming, causing millions of people to face a water shortage crisis.
2.explanation_zh: they 指上一句的冰川；「近年來已經受到…嚴重影響」用現在完成式被動 have been seriously affected by；「造成數百萬人面臨…」是結果，用句尾分詞 causing… to face；「缺水危機」譯 a water shortage crisis（也可 a water crisis／water shortages）。

issues_zh: 第 1 部分「然而，近年來它們」收了 However, they／However, these glaciers／However, the glaciers 等不含「近年來」的寫法（為了配合 ref[2] 把 in recent years 放到句尾），第 2 部分也收了不含時間詞的 have been seriously affected by global warming；兩部分獨立比對時，整句漏譯「近年來」的 However, they have been seriously affected by global warming, causing … 仍四個部分全對。建議第 1 部分註明：不含時間詞的寫法只有在句尾補上 in recent years 時才算，否則漏譯「近年來」扣第 1 部分。
（小意見，不影響判定）ref[2] 的 putting millions of people at risk of a water crisis 把「面臨缺水危機」說成「有發生缺水危機的風險」，語氣比原文弱一些；可以接受，但較不貼近原文。

problems: 第 2 題驗證者對4 部分切分有意見（warn）：第 1 部分「然而，近年來它們」收了 However, they／However, these glaciers／However, the glaciers 等不含「近年來」的寫法（為了配合 ref[2] 把 in recent years

1.translation: It is hard to imagine that the water millions of people rely on every day is supplied by the glaciers melting high in the mountains.
1.explanation_zh: 「很難想像……」用形式主詞 It is hard to imagine that ...。「數百萬人每天依賴的水」用省略關係代名詞的 the water millions of people rely on every day（rely on 的受詞就是 water）。「是由……提供的」用被動 is supplied by；也可以用主動 comes from。「高山上正在融化的冰川」用 the glaciers melting high in the mountains，melting 表示正在進行。

2.translation: However, in recent years they have been seriously affected by global warming, causing millions of people to face a water shortage crisis.
2.explanation_zh: 「已經受到……影響」用現在完成式被動 have been seriously affected by；in recent years 搭配完成式。「它們」依上一句指冰川（glaciers），用 they。「造成數百萬人面臨缺水危機」用現在分詞 causing ... to face 表結果，water shortage crisis 對應「缺水危機」。

status_reason: 判定者人工檢查退回（record_verification 判 verified；盲譯 A 已對第 2 句切分給 warn）：第 1 句第 4 部分「提供的」的 accepted 收了 are provided by、are supplied by，但第 2 部分每種寫法的主詞都是不可數的 the water，動詞只能用 is，評分規準把主詞動詞不一致當成正確；第 2 句第 1 部分「然而，近年來它們」收了 However, they／However, these glaciers／However, the glaciers 等不含「近年來」的寫法，第 2 部分也收不含時間詞的 have been seriously affected by global warming，整句漏譯「近年來」仍四個部分全拿。重生後仍不過，停在 rejected。
